initial_application: No explicit FHIR-5694-tagged core commit was found. reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. A source edit would risk reintroducing obsolete or ambiguous security-label placement for operational subsetting; current search, REST, common-tags, and terminology references already convey the correct rule.
